bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? The integration will connect to the amp to verify it works.

user.description: Choose a Marshall CODE amplifier to set up.

manual.description: Enter the amp's Bluetooth MAC address (e.g. 2C:6B:7D:81:98:57). The amp must be powered on and within range of an adapter or Bluetooth proxy.

controller.title: Choose Bluetooth controller
controller.description: The connection failed with automatic selection. Pick the adapter or Bluetooth proxy closest to the amp and try again. Scanners that currently see the amp are listed with their signal strength.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Marshall CODE amplifiers found

error.not_visible: The amp isn't visible to any Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Wake the amp, disconnect it from your phone, move it closer to the adapter/ESPHome proxy and try again.
error.not_connectable: The amp is only seen by a passive scanner. Set the adapter to Active scanning, or use an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with `active: true`.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't open a Bluetooth connection to the amp. Make sure nothing else (e.g. the Marshall Gateway app) is connected to it, then try again.
error.missing_characteristic: Connected, but the amp doesn't expose the expected control characteristics. Enable debug logging and check the 'GATT services' warning.
error.no_response: Connected, but the amp didn't answer. Power-cycle the amp and try again.
error.invalid_address: That isn't a valid MAC address (expected format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).
